_comment: Policies exactly as Norviq 0.2.5 stored them: each generator at v0.2.5, run on the inputs shown,
output byte for byte. Every one holds a bare {} / set() / [] / [][_] that OPA 1.21 refuses to compile.
The generators did not change between v0.2.5 and the 0.2.6 commit that replaced those literals,
so these are also what 0.2.6 development builds stored before it. Read by
tests/engine/test_legacy_empty_literals.py. Regenerating them from the CURRENT generators would
defeat the purpose: they must stay what an upgrading cluster actually has in Postgres.
